decisions.reason: The camera sits squarely on the firm's optical and star-tracker heritage, so management can read mission feedback and improve it through its own R&D, and it may also take over the role of the withdrawn modular line B.

Space situational awareness is an adjacent, growing field where the firm's sensor know-how and its university and EU research cooperation supply the related knowledge to assimilate early results and refine the suite.

The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's docking and rendezvous sensor expertise and fits its push toward smaller spacecraft, and long qualification cycles mean early low visibility is not yet a reason to withdraw it.
This newly launched radiation-hard camera line, shown on its own page, draws directly on core space-qualified imaging know-how that management can interpret and develop further.

Asteroid navigation imaging extends the firm's navigation camera heritage into deep-space missions where agency and research partners provide the learning base, so one year is too early to judge this mission-driven product.
